description: This Java source file defines the HonoBasicAuthHandler class, a custom implementation extending Vert.x's BasicAuthHandlerImpl. It handles HTTP Basic Authentication, processes exceptions, and integrates OpenTracing for distributed tracing within the Hono framework.

classes.name: HonoBasicAuthHandler
classes.description: A custom BasicAuthHandler for Hono that adds exception processing and tracing capabilities.

methods.name: HonoBasicAuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with an auth provider, realm, and tracer.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during authentication, sending appropriate HTTP error responses.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Parses credentials from the routing context, with custom handling for malformed headers and span context injection.
